venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Another crisp, cool evening. A little chilly as the sun went down, but overall a beautiful night considering its Mid January.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Thursday 1/15.** Quiet after 8:30pm, but ran ~90% of a usual weekend flow before that, anchored by three large parties in by 6:30 that stayed several rounds; never hit a legit waitlist. Late run of Via employee party guests; conference and company-party attendees have been an unusual share of business lately. Wildest order denied: Frangelico on the rocks; accepted: Laphroaig Select shaken hard. 5 large parties, 8 solos, 15 investor cocktails; comps $132.93 (about a third investor, plus a large F&F tab). Top sellers: Grand Entrance, First Time Listener, Revenant. Door: two 5 tops and a 6 on reservations plus a small walk-in line; house mostly full by 6:50, quiet after 8pm, no 10pm wave, very cold and windy after a warm week; saw Alexis and friends and industry/friends of Seth. No no-shows. Kitchen: lots of fries. Repairs: board under sink outside upstairs bathroom detached.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Thursday 1/15.** Slow but smooth. Cold weather kept foot traffic minimal; decent early flow then the pace crawled. Aggressive cuts, ending with just the bar team and MOD; natural last call, last guest in before 11pm, final table out at midnight. Team connected well with guests. Kitchen: smooth night with great food sales; lots of food early to larger parties, bar snacks later. MOD: Kevin.
